# [STORY] As a user, I want to chat with the AI assistant from the frontend, so that I can ask conversational questions about movies

## User Story
**As a** user
**I want** to chat with the AI assistant from the frontend
**So that** I can ask conversational questions about movies and get a persisted, ongoing conversation

## Parent Epic
Parent: #195

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [ ] Given a logged-in user opens the chat assistant, when they send a message, then the frontend calls `POST /api/v1/ai/chat` and displays the assistant's reply
- [ ] Given a user continues an existing conversation, when they send a follow-up message, then the frontend includes the stored `conversationId` so the conversation persists server-side
- [ ] Given a user starts a brand-new conversation, when they send the first message, then no `conversationId` is sent, and the frontend stores the one returned in the response for subsequent messages
- [ ] Given the chat call fails, when the user has sent a message, then the frontend shows a clear error state without losing the user's typed message
